scientific_findings.reason: The original reported average real GDP growth for public-debt-to-GDP over 90% is -0.1%, but reanalysis shows the correct figure is about +2.2%. This discrepancy arises from errors including data exclusions, a spreadsheet coding error, and unconventional weighting by country rather than country-year, heavily biasing estimates downward.

The original methodology uses non-parametric grouping of data into debt/GDP buckets and compares averages without regression controls, ignoring potential confounders or dynamics. Also, selective data exclusion and weighting choices strongly affect results, limiting robustness.
The reported average growth rate of 2.2% for public debt to GDP over 90% matches the corrected computations from the replication dataset, correcting previous errors.
